adoption.rationale: The server resolves event PR numbers as positive integers and serializes them into the local action protocol. The receiver rejects malformed action lines before calling process_pr. This adopts the final shell-side positive decimal token invariant and does not claim an attacker can inject arbitrary action-pipe data.

declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; canonical decimal strings produced by the pinned server from positive Python integers, delivered as a single action token. Property scope is the shell dispatcher condition at line 302 and its PROCESS_PR dispatch sink.
guarantee: The receiver dispatches process_pr only when the PROCESS_PR action has exactly one positive decimal PR-number token after the repository slug and no extra fields; nondecimal text, zero, and negative values do not reach process_pr.
input_source: Pull-request numbers resolved from GitHub webhook event fields by the pinned Python server, which accepts only positive integers and serializes them as decimal text in the local PROCESS_PR action. The shell receiver validates this protocol token before dispatch.
